Diego M.: Hi everyone :wave: I'm Diego (Platform Eng) — first day! Dock arrived but I'm hitting a couple issues: the USB‑C PD only reports 30W (my MBP M2 14" should charge at 96W) and the onboard Ethernet adapter doesn't show any interface. Also when I try to join CompanyCorp-Enterprise wifi my Mac asks for a client cert I don't have. I opened ticket IT-4827. Any quick troubleshooting I can try while IT looks?

Samir K.: Welcome Diego! Quick checks: 1) what cable are you using (is it the white braided USB4 that came with the dock)? 2) can you confirm the dock model printed on the underside? 3) run `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` and `networksetup -listallhardwareports` and paste output here.

Diego M.: Thanks — cable is the white braided USB4 that came in the box. Dock label reads "Calypso USB4 Dock v2" serial CLY-92FJ. Ran commands, paste below (redacted):
```
$ system_profiler SPUSBDataType
Thunderbolt Bus:
  Calypso USB4 Dock v2:
    Product ID: 0x23ab
    Vendor ID: 0x1d6b
    Version: 1.0
    Speed: Up to 40 Gb/s
    Current Available (mA): 30000
```
```
$ networksetup -listallhardwareports
Hardware Port: Wi-Fi
Device: en0
Ethernet Address: aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff
Hardware Port: USB 10/100/1000 LAN
Device: —
```
Looks like the dock is only advertising 30, and there's no device name for the LAN.

Samir K.: Ok that matches the symptoms. Two lanes to check: cable/PD negotiation and dock firmware. Sometimes the dock ships with a limited PD profile. Can you try with a direct Mac charger (if available) and then plug dock in after the Mac is on? That'll verify the PD path. If you can, try a different USB4 cable (some cables are data-only).

Samir K.: Also, we push a firmware fix for Calypso v1.0.3 that enables the full PD table and re-enables the Ethernet controller. I can push the firmware update remotely but it requires a helper utility we ship via a bootable USB. Do you have an extra USB-A or USB-C stick? If not, we can ship a prepped stick or send a loaner dongle.

Priya S.: fwiw I had the same dock last month — firmware update fixed my ethernet not enumerating. Samir, we still have the fw image on the IT share right? (I can bring a stick if needed).

Samir K.: Yep, I have the image. Diego, two options: 1) If you can bring your laptop to the office IT bench I'll flash it in ~15 mins. 2) I can overnight a prepped USB stick and a short Ethernet dongle. Which do you prefer? Also for the Wi-Fi cert: you'll need the CompanyCorp client cert installed from our SSO portal (IT KB: https://kb.redwood/example/wifi-cert). Steps: open Self-Service -> Networking -> Install CompanyCorp Cert, then join network with username diego@redwood.com.

Diego M.: I'm remote today (SF) so option 2 please — overnight stick and a dongle would be perfect. I'll try the direct charger trick now and report back. Thanks for the KB link.

Samir K.: Cool. I've updated IT ticket IT-4827: scheduled overnight shipment (dock-fw-usbstick + USB‑Ethernet dongle). Tracking: https://ship.example/track/1Z999AA10123456784. ETA 1 business day. I'll also attach the firmware image to the ticket so you can see release notes.

it-bot: Ticket IT-4827 updated by Samir K.: "Hardware swap + firmware flash scheduled; overnight shipment created."

Diego M.: Tried with my MBP charger first, then dock — charger shows 96W, when I plug the dock back in it drops to 30W again. So sounds like firmware or dock negotiated profile only. Thanks for shipping the stick.

Jordan L.: Welcome Diego! If you need anything else (access, onboarding walkthroughs), ping me or Priya. Also happy to loan a desk if you want to come by for the flash.

Samir K.: Noted. I'll mark the ticket with the tracking and tentative resolve; please re-open if the firmware flash doesn't bring back the Ethernet and PD.

Diego M.: Awesome — appreciate the fast help :raised_hands: Will update once the dongle/stick arrives and I try the flash.
